status: Unpublished Core immutable-converter projection preparation, qualified against merged Ari #239 and public alpha.149.
baseline_modules: Exact frozen candidate runtime from Ari prepared-protocol-source qualification (merged #239). Same original X12 test assembly and harness in both variants; remote-only recovery observation limits do not affect these in-memory cases.
package_provenance: Control Core and all other packaged DLLs are from previously verified public alpha.149 at merged publisher c262a431142e77c6365f38360a01606f6e411661. Candidate replaces only Cohesive.dll with a build of that source plus the checked-in projection fix. This is unpublished source qualification, not an adopted package. No package cache mutation or source-analyzer override.
measurement: 32 alternating fresh processes, 832 successful original X12 cases: default five pairs/source at 32 invocations/process; separate no-tiering diagnostic three pairs/source at 16. No agent-controlled builds, tests or traces overlap the untraced measurements.
statistics: Per-process median in fixed windows, then median across independent processes. Default later window 17..32; no-tiering diagnostic 9..16. CPU, JIT and GC overlap; never subtract them as disjoint buckets. Cumulative allocations are not retained heap.
validation: Full Core Release suite: 4946 pass /41 existing skips, including 15 new regressions. Full Ari engine suite in an isolated runtime with the source Core DLL: 996 pass /18 existing skips. No Ari source or generated acceptance changes. Converter output, concurrent first use, mutable fallback, changed owners, duplicate and malformed rejection, retries, depth, collection and warm 512-byte allocation ceiling are covered.
result: Default second allocation 14.015 to 12.124 MB /15.000 to 12.685 MB (13.5% /15.4% less), CPU 197.3 to 180.7 ms /227.1 to 206.5 ms (8.4% /9.1% lower). Cold allocation approximately flat. Later default CPU lower but elapsed mixed; no-tiering diagnostic CPU 14% /13% lower. Sampled benefit is primarily seeding/control workflow and preview, not durable execution. See report for complete windows and residual work.
trace_quality: 12 matched traces /24 phases: zero lost events, missing allocation stacks and missing managed CPU stacks.
component_benchmark: BenchmarkDotNet ShortRun, six cases: 1/128 nested items, uncached serializer reference vs cold owner vs warm owner. The serializer reference is independent, not a same-binary old-path comparison. Run sequentially before untraced X12 runs. Cold preparation allocates and retains state; warm owner reuse has zero measured allocation.
